title: Weather figure
description: One weather figure drawn by the app from case data (historical or simulated), never an image model: a radar display, satellite image, sounding, meteogram, model panel, ensemble plume or mesoanalysis map. The figure carries its own data; the writer gives a heading and the source line, and the app draws the figure and prints its text summary and data table.

source.description: Where the data come from, for example "NEXRAD Level II, KILN, historical"

hideTable.description: Leave out the data table beside the figure

figures.description: The figure to draw, as { main: { kind, data } }. Kinds: radar, skew_t, hodograph, satellite, model_panel, mesoanalysis, meteogram, ensemble_plume, decision_timeline.

options.description: Optional width and height in pixels
